report:
Reviewed the full precedence claim, all six implementation associations and all associated tests, including every complete lookup_precedence.rs fixture and the in-memory cyclic-glob test. Captured the resolution design, compile-test preparation/assertion and observation helpers, and in-memory root setup. Source inspection only; no test reruns or source changes.

The claim makes lookup sensitive to scope, namespace and path form, and requires lexical exit/restoration with stable body-local identity/type despite other allocations. ribs.rs scans newest scopes and entries first. Resolver uses ribs for ordinary single-segment unqualified paths, while qualified/anchored paths follow their module anchors and segments; the explicit receiver spelling self has its dedicated value lookup. Normal module lookup searches direct/named imports before globs, then external/standard/language preludes; in-flight lookup keys break cyclic import recursion and identity dedup avoids false ambiguity from repeated routes. symbol.rs assigns namespace per item and preserves namespace on external edges. scope.rs selects the edition prelude. expr.rs clones scope and pushes a block rib; infer_ctx.rs allocates locals from the body's global local list while storing types by LocalId in each lexical scope map, preserving IDs despite nested/sibling gaps. Macro-expansion lookup has its documented phase-specific rules, which are not claimed fully verified by the ordinary namespace fixture.

The source fixtures provide exact assertions, not names alone. local_shadowing_does_not_change_qualified_lookup distinguishes parameter local#1, crate function and later local#2. nested_scope_shadowing_restores_the_outer_binding requires inner bool/local#2, restored u16/local#1 and later after binding/type. sibling_scopes_do_not_share_bindings_or_local_type_slots requires distinct bool/u8 locals and the original u16 parameter. qualified_paths_select_the_named_module_scope checks self/super/crate/explicit ancestry against exact function paths; absolute_external_paths_bypass_a_shadowing_local_module distinguishes crate::std from external std. type_value_and_macro_namespaces_are_independent checks Same as function, generated macro output and struct/field types.

direct_items_take_precedence_over_globs and explicit_imports_take_precedence_over_globs require the direct or named/renamed definition respectively. named_type_import_takes_precedence_over_the_standard_prelude requires custom::Option. repeated_glob_routes_to_one_definition_are_unambiguous requires the single origin identity; competing_glob_definitions_remain_ambiguous_despite_equal_types requires <unresolved> plus the exact two-candidate diagnostic. enum_glob_import_resolves_a_variant and external_enum_glob_import_resolves_a_variant require exact local Choice::Selected and std Ordering::Less identities. transitive_cyclic_globs_resolve_a_value_definition requires the third module's value; transitive_local_globs_resolve_and_glob_cycles_terminate separately inspects the resolved Item ADT and requires an error type for Missing through the cycle.

The four edition fixtures require TryInto in 2021 but an unresolved-trait diagnostic in 2018, and IntoFuture in 2024 but a diagnostic in 2021. Positive cases assert completed generic value types and the harness rejects unexpected diagnostics; negative cases assert exact diagnostics. Captured helpers show real Sage execution with exact symbol/type/diagnostic comparisons and compiler-condition validation, rather than mock resolution answers.

The explicit resolution_lookup_precedence TODO is now narrow: remaining macro subnamespace distinctions and Rust 2015 path rules. Completing that remaining import/path matrix is prerequisite to full claim verification. Those cases remain deferred, not silently inferred from the bang-macro or later-edition tests. All implementation entries and tests are accounted for, with substantial ordinary coverage distinguished from these remaining requirements. No concrete defect was identified in the reviewed paths and no additional edits are requested.
